The Run Object ​

Field reference for Run. Optional fields are marked ?; absent generally means inherit or legacy record, not empty.

Identity & ownership ​

FieldTypeMeaning
idstringRun id
orgId?stringOwning org (absent on legacy local records = local)
createdBy?stringThe member who started it. Budgets, permissions, and connections resolve against this user for every turn
createdByName? / createdByEmail?stringCreator's display identity, stamped at creation
sharedWith?string[]Members invited to view. Viewers watch; they do not steer
titlestringShort human title, derived from the brief
briefstringThe original brief

State ​

FieldTypeMeaning
statusRunStatusactive | awaiting_input | paused | done | error | cancelled
createdAt / updatedAtnumberEpoch ms
attention?RunAttentionLatest attention-worthy transition; its id changes only on entering a new such state, so reconnecting clients de-duplicate without losing it
lastResult?stringLatest committed summary (preview source)
lastActivity?stringMost recent live status line (best-effort)

Target & execution ​

FieldTypeMeaning
project?stringPrimary project (coding runs)
branch?stringPrimary working branch
executionMode?'guided' | 'autonomous'Who drives the dispatch loop. Absent = legacy autonomous
effortMode?EffortModeStamped at creation; drives the model/reasoning preset
providerProfile? / model?stringRun-wide overrides; ''/absent = inherit
agentConfigs?Record<string, RunAgentConfig>Per-actor overrides, keyed by 'PRIME', a project, or an agent. The most-specific layer
version?stringThe orchestrator build that started the run. Stamped once, never updated

Plan ​

FieldTypeMeaning
checklist?ChecklistItem[]The live plan
originalChecklist?ChecklistItem[]The plan exactly as first frozen — makes drift visible
planVersion?number1 = set once, never amended
planApproval?PlanApprovalOperator sign-off on the plan (not the work)
playbookId?stringSet when the plan was replayed from a playbook rather than re-derived
appliedMemories?AppliedMemory[]Memory selected before planning and held stable

Participants & sessions ​

FieldTypeMeaning
participantsRunParticipant[]Every agent that has taken part, PRIME included
primeSessionId?stringPRIME's session for this run, separate from the main chat
primeNeedsRehydrate?booleanPRIME was compacted and not re-briefed. While set, the live-state block carries the full plan; the engine clears it once sent

In-flight ​

FieldTypeMeaning
inFlights?RunInFlight[]Every executing delegation, durable across a crash
inFlight?RunInFlightLegacy single-flight field, read only for backward-compatible recovery
pendingApproval?PendingApprovalPresent iff parked at an approval gate

Thread & accounting ​

FieldTypeMeaning
threadRunEvent[]The ordered shared conversation
usageLog?RunUsageEntry[]One entry per settled LLM call
verificationLog?TaskVerificationRecord[]Every gate verdict, append-only, run-level
optimizationReport?RunOptimizationReportFirst-pass count, retries, failure kinds, cost, max context
optimizationMode?'off' | 'shadow' | 'canary' | 'on'Rollout state, stamped at creation so a result is attributable

RunEvent ​

FieldMeaning
actorOPERATOR | PRIME | a project/agent name | SYSTEM
kindmessage | delegation | question | answer | tool | result | system
to?Directed-at target (e.g. PRIME delegates to: "my-app")
text / detail?The message, and the full tool call/output for the expandable row
byUser?For an OPERATOR event: which member sent or decided it
stats?This message's own token/cost vitals

RunEventStats ​

inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadTokens?, cacheCreationTokens?, ms?, contextTokens?, costUsd?, model?, and costShared? — the last meaning the cost is this message's share of a turn total rather than a provider-quoted per-call price.

RunSummary ​

The compact list view: the same identity, status, and plan fields without the full thread, plus participants (keys only), participantContexts, preview, attachments, and the live inFlights.
